svg.title: MOON Lab, IISER Bhopal, Undergraduate researcher, 2 years
svg.desc: MOON Lab, IISER Bhopal, undergraduate researcher for two years, advised by Dr. P. B. Sujit. Perception, state estimation, adaptive control and GNSS-denied navigation; algorithms deployed on Jetson edge devices and drones; Python implementation of OpenVINS.
svg.text: Perception, state estimation, GNSS-denied navigation, drone hardware.
